question: How many submissions are in the queue by triage lane, with total TIV?
Show the hail-belt habitational loss ratio by quarter for roofs over 15 years vs newer roofs
Which queued submissions have documents that disagree with the application?
Which segment's loss ratio deteriorated the most over the last four quarters?
Which perils drove hail-belt habitational losses in the last four quarters?
What is our hit ratio by broker tier over the last 12 months?
What does the appetite bulletin say about hail-belt habitational roofs older than 15 years, and when does a submission need CUO referral?

description: Appetite, documentation and authority rules with their guideline reference (doc_ref) and action.
Brokers appointed with Tidewell (tier Premier / Preferred / Standard).
Claims by accident quarter (2024-Q3 to 2026-Q2): peril (Hail, Wind, Fire, Water damage, ...), incurred_amount = paid + reserve. Numerator of loss ratios.
Per broker, trailing 12 months: submissions, quoted, bound, declined, hit_ratio (bound / quoted), bound_premium, and book_loss_ratio of the broker's policies.

PREFERRED for loss-ratio questions: per quarter x portfolio_cell x roof_band: earned_premium, incurred, wind_hail_incurred, claim_count, loss_ratio. portfolio_cell values: 'Habitational · Hail belt', 'Habitational · Other states', 'Retail & Restaurants', 'Light Manufacturing', 'Warehouse & Distribution', 'Office & Professional', 'Hospitality'. roof_band: 'Roof > 15 yrs' / 'Roof <= 15 yrs'.

TODAY'S QUEUE (Mon 28 Sep 2026), one row per new submission: application values (app_*) vs AI-extracted SOV (sov_*) and loss runs (lr_*), discrepancies (array), rules_hit (array of rule IDs), p_as_submitted / p_verified (ML risk), band_as_submitted / band_verified, triage_lane, priority_score, premium_potential, days_to_effective.
AI-extracted prior-carrier loss-run claims for queued submissions: loss_date, line, loc_no, cause, paid, reserve, total_incurred, status, wind_hail flag.

Tidewell commercial property / package policies (12-month terms, effective Jul-2023 to Jun-2026) with the underwriting characteristics at bind: segment, state, hail_belt (TX OK KS NE CO), construction, roof_age_years, sprinklered, protection_class, tiv, written_premium, broker_id.
Earned premium per policy per calendar quarter (2024-Q3 to 2026-Q2). Denominator of loss ratios.

AI-extracted (ai_parse_document + ai_query) statement-of-values rows for queued submissions: one row per building with construction, year_built, roof_year, roof_age_years, sprinklered, protection_class, tiv.
Historical submissions received May-2024 to Sep-2026 with outcome BOUND / QUOTED_NOT_BOUND / DECLINED and decline_reason.
submission_risk_model@champion scores per queued submission: p_as_submitted (on the application) vs p_verified (on SOV + loss runs); bands Low < 0.25 <= Moderate < 0.45 <= High; drivers.

Decisions issued by the underwriting desk from the app (QUOTE, QUOTE_WITH_CONDITIONS, DECLINE) with premium, excluded locations, conditions, rationale, decided_by and decided_at. Empty until the desk issues a decision.

content:
Tidewell Specialty Insurance is a FICTIONAL US middle-market commercial property & package insurer. Today is Monday 28 September 2026.
Loss ratio (LR) = SUM(incurred) / SUM(earned_premium), always aggregated as a ratio of sums, never an average of row-level loss_ratio. Show it as a percentage with 0 decimals.
Portfolio data runs by accident quarter from 2024-Q3 to 2026-Q2; the latest COMPLETE quarter is 2026-Q2. 'Last four quarters' = 2025-Q3, 2025-Q4, 2026-Q1, 2026-Q2; 'prior four quarters' = 2024-Q3 .. 2025-Q2. Quarter strings sort chronologically.
Use gold_portfolio_quarterly for any loss-ratio question by segment / portfolio cell / roof band / quarter. 'Hail belt' = TX, OK, KS, NE, CO. 'Hail-belt habitational' = portfolio_cell 'Habitational · Hail belt'. 'Old roofs' = roof_band 'Roof > 15 yrs'.
When asked which segment deteriorated, compare the last four quarters with the prior four quarters per portfolio_cell and report both loss ratios and the change in points.
Hit ratio = bound / quoted (quoted = BOUND + QUOTED_NOT_BOUND). Use gold_broker_performance for broker questions (trailing 12 months).
Questions about 'the queue', 'open submissions' or 'new submissions' use gold_submission_queue (24 rows). TIV in the queue = sov_tiv (verified). Sort the queue by priority_score DESC.
Money in USD; format large values in $K or $M.
ROUTING: numbers, counts, amounts, rates, trends -> query the TABLES (SQL); never answer numbers from a document. Policy, procedure, guideline, contract and 'what does the document say' questions -> search the attached documents and cite the document name + section.

question: How many submissions are in the queue by triage lane, with total TIV?
sql: SELECT triage_lane, COUNT(*) AS submissions, ROUND(SUM(sov_tiv) / 1e6, 1) AS tiv_musd, ROUND(SUM(premium_potential)) AS premium_potential FROM financial_services.commercial_underwriting_copilot.gold_submission_queue GROUP BY triage_lane ORDER BY submissions DESC

question: Which queued submissions have documents that disagree with the application?
sql: SELECT submission_id, insured_name, broker_name, ROUND(sov_tiv / 1e6, 1) AS tiv_musd, band_as_submitted, band_verified, discrepancies FROM financial_services.commercial_underwriting_copilot.gold_submission_queue WHERE discrepancy_count > 0 ORDER BY priority_score DESC

question: Which segment's loss ratio deteriorated the most over the last four quarters?
sql: SELECT portfolio_cell, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN quarter BETWEEN '2024-Q3' AND '2025-Q2' THEN incurred END) / SUM(CASE WHEN quarter BETWEEN '2024-Q3' AND '2025-Q2' THEN earned_premium END), 0) AS prior_4q_lr_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN quarter BETWEEN '2025-Q3' AND '2026-Q2' THEN incurred END) / SUM(CASE WHEN quarter BETWEEN '2025-Q3' AND '2026-Q2' THEN earned_premium END), 0) AS last_4q_lr_pct, last_4q_lr_pct - prior_4q_lr_pct AS change_pts FROM financial_services.commercial_underwriting_copilot.gold_portfolio_quarterly GROUP BY portfolio_cell ORDER BY change_pts DESC

question: Book loss ratio by quarter
sql: SELECT quarter, ROUND(SUM(earned_premium)) AS earned_premium, ROUND(SUM(incurred)) AS incurred, ROUND(100 * SUM(incurred) / SUM(earned_premium), 0) AS loss_ratio_pct FROM financial_services.commercial_underwriting_copilot.gold_portfolio_quarterly GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

question: Which perils drove hail-belt habitational losses in the last four quarters?
sql: SELECT c.peril, COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(SUM(c.incurred_amount)) AS incurred, ROUND(100 * SUM(c.incurred_amount) / SUM(SUM(c.incurred_amount)) OVER (), 0) AS share_pct FROM financial_services.commercial_underwriting_copilot.claims c JOIN financial_services.commercial_underwriting_copilot.policies p ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id WHERE p.segment_code = 'HAB' AND p.hail_belt AND c.accident_quarter BETWEEN '2025-Q3' AND '2026-Q2' GROUP BY c.peril ORDER BY incurred DESC

question: Top 5 submissions in the queue by priority
sql: SELECT submission_id, insured_name, segment, state, ROUND(sov_tiv / 1e6, 1) AS tiv_musd, triage_lane, priority_score, band_verified FROM financial_services.commercial_underwriting_copilot.gold_submission_queue ORDER BY priority_score DESC LIMIT 5

question: Hit ratio by broker tier over the last 12 months
sql: SELECT tier, SUM(submissions) AS submissions, SUM(quoted) AS quoted, SUM(bound) AS bound, ROUND(100 * SUM(bound) / SUM(quoted), 0) AS hit_ratio_pct, ROUND(SUM(bound_premium)) AS bound_premium FROM financial_services.commercial_underwriting_copilot.gold_broker_performance GROUP BY tier ORDER BY hit_ratio_pct DESC

question: Hail-belt habitational loss ratio by quarter, roofs over 15 years vs newer
sql: SELECT quarter, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN roof_band = 'Roof > 15 yrs' THEN incurred END) / SUM(CASE WHEN roof_band = 'Roof > 15 yrs' THEN earned_premium END), 0) AS old_roof_lr_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN roof_band = 'Roof <= 15 yrs' THEN incurred END) / SUM(CASE WHEN roof_band = 'Roof <= 15 yrs' THEN earned_premium END), 0) AS newer_roof_lr_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(incurred) / SUM(earned_premium), 0) AS total_lr_pct FROM financial_services.commercial_underwriting_copilot.gold_portfolio_quarterly WHERE portfolio_cell = 'Habitational · Hail belt' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter
